notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Dominion Saboteur from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Dominion Saboteur.
Dominion Saboteur triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat each turn.
